about: What this file is: the shot check for the Works' view W2 (No. 2's open gate, flat out; the subject is the open gateway: its leaves, swung into the yard, and the crates standing in it) (paper-film/blender/inflation-chapter-2-newcomers/works/assemble_works.py, plan 34 part 1 'A. The Works'): which objects make up each prop and figure, their parts in the story, the lane's direction, where the typed words go. Each waiting man is his own group, so the checker counts them and draws their outlines (solo/NAME.png). Used by paper-film/blender/shot_facts.py and paper-film/tools/check_shot.py; run from the kit's top folder with BLEND=assets/models/inflation-chapter-2-newcomers/works/works-lane.blend paper-film/tools/check-shot.sh paper-film/blender/inflation-chapter-2-newcomers/works/assemble_works.py THIS_FILE OUT [PICTURE] -- --view w2.
